name: samadhaan
description: AI-powered civic problem intelligence and resolution platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && concurrently -n api,web,ai -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @samadhaan/shared && npm run build --workspace @samadhaan/api && npm run build --workspace @samadhaan/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @samadhaan/api && npm run lint --workspace @samadhaan/web && npm run lint:ai
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @samadhaan/api && npm run test --workspace @samadhaan/web && npm run test:ai
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
